text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: AaaaaAAH?! Look, it's Curren! Oh no, she's so cuteeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tracen is holding an open campus today, and Curren's surrounded by a crowd of younger Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student B
text_block_list.text: Uh, um… You posted that you're going to run in your muse dress today, right? The one that Beauty Anshinzawa designed?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup, I'll be out in my muse racewear for the scrimmage, so look forward to it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student B
text_block_list.text: I will! I can't believe I get to see you in it up close! I'm so glad I came all the way to Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Curren! Looks like you're ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hi, Bakushin O! Let's make this a great race!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student C
text_block_list.text: Wow, the scrimmage has Curren Chan and Sakura Bakushin O?! This is gonna be a sprinter showdown!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: A sprinter… showdown?! The competition's tough, but I know Curren'll win it! Good luck, Curreeen!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! ♪ I'll give it all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a crowd this electrified, it doesn't feel like just a scrimmage. The runners take off like it's a real showdown!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm in great shape!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Curren's hot on my heels! But not for long—haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushiiin! Baku Baku! Shin Shin! BAKUSHIIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! That's crazy fast! Bakushin is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whew, that was a good Bakushin! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student B
text_block_list.text: Wow… I can't believe that was real. Bakushin's speed was the stuff of dreams!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student C
text_block_list.text: Right? I hope I get into Tracen! I wanna learn how to Bakushin just like Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: Me too! I wanna Bakushin! Bakushiiin! Bakushiiiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Onlookers
text_block_list.text: Ba! Ku! Shin! Ba! Ku! Shiiin!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O! That was a really impressive Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Why, thank you! I'm glad to hear that you appreciate the power of Bakushining!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's an expression of raw, true speed, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oooh! It is indeed! You completely get it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup, it feels like your Bakushin has a lot in common with my cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You see, I aim to make everyone's heart leap with a dazzling flash of speed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Me flying across the track, sparkling like a shooting star… That's the cute Curren I wanna burn into everyone's memories! So I promise you, I'll outrun your Bakushin next time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Then I await your challenge! We've still got plenty of races ahead of us!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: I think that's the most serious I've ever heard Curren sound! The way she's so determined… She's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student B
text_block_list.text: Like, you can just see how passionate she is! You can feel it! CURREEEEN! YOU'LL WIN THE NEXT ONE!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Thanks, everyone! I'll train lots, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But don't think we're done here yet! Bakushin O and I will show you just how cute winning concerts are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin! Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin! Bakushin! Bakushin! Bakushin shiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student C
text_block_list.text: Woooo! Hehe, this song is so silly, but Curren's totally nailing the crazy Bakushin energy!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: This over-the-top angle from Curren is so unexpected, but so cute! Bakushins have never looked this adorable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's song for the winning live is upbeat and must take a ton of energy, but Curren is rocking it. The crowd's going wild!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, your song is so fun, Bakushin O! I wanna try doing a verse with the crowd too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What should I use in place of Bakushin? …Ooh, let's do Kawaii!

text_block_list.name: Onlookers
text_block_list.text: Kawaii, Kawaii, Kawaii! Kawaii, Kawaii, Kawaii!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you all for indulging me with that! ♪ C'mon, let's keep on singing together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The performance continues, alternating the fan chant between Bakushin and Kawaii. Afterwards, we get rave reviews that Curren's fan interaction really made everyone feel like part of the show!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oooh, I see a "Luv Curren" sign out there! ♪

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: No way?! Sh-she noticed… She's so cute, aaaaah I can't! I LOVE YOU, CURREN! YOU'RE THE CUTEST!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bakushin O! I've got a really cute pose idea to show everyone how much we appreciate their support. Wanna try it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But of course! What kind of pose are you thinking?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just do what I do! Ready… Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Curren & Bakushin
text_block_list.text: Luv U! ♪

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student C
text_block_list.text: Th-they're so cuuuute! Literal angels of adorableness! Thank you for my liiiife!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren may have lost the race, but she still seizes the prospective students' hearts with her super cute winning concert performance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Keep your eyes on me, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've got plenty more Bakushins to go around!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student C
text_block_list.text: Whoa… It's a winning contest between Cute Curren and Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student A
text_block_list.text: The clash of their styles is really heating things up! I've never seen a concert like this!

text_block_list.name: Prospective Student B
text_block_list.text: Everyone at Tracen's really out to win! They're showing us just how determined students here are!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, if you make it into Tracen, I'll show you what a blast bein' cute is! ♪

text_block_list.name: Onlookers
text_block_list.text: I-I can't wait! You're the cutest, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, I learn that most of the kids at the concert applied to Tracen. Just goes to show how much influence an influencer truly has…
